home.title: Boyei malamu na {{app}}
home.tagline: Lisanga moko mpo na kozonga ndako mpe kovanda kolongonu.

area.comingSoon: Ekozala awa. Esika oyo ezali ya moke sikoyo.

wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Okoki kokanga esaleli moko poso moko, poso mibale, sanza moko to libela. Buton ya likama, lisungi ya kozonga, baninga ya kobenga mpe kolongola data ekangamaka te.

community.noPhone: Banumero ya telefone bamonanaka te na bansango kati na biso.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.meetingsTitle: Mabongisi ya matambe zomi na mibale mpe kozonga

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Bomba mosungi to moninga ya bokengi pembeni na yo.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Oyo elongolaka solo data na yo, kozonga te.
safety.wipeConfirm: Nazali koyeba ete oyo ekolongola solo data na ngai.

reentry.noSteps: Matambe ya liste nanu mayei te.
reentry.tipsTitle: Batokoli longwa epai ya bato oyo basalaki
reentry.tipsAnonymous: Batokoli bazali na nkombo te. Banumero ya telefone bamonanaka te.
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Nini esungaki yo na litambe oyo?
reentry.celebrationFirst: Litambe ya liboso esili — boyie ndako.
reentry.celebrationAll: Matambe 33 esili. Sepela na botamboli na yo.
reentry.crisisStep: Bomba banumero oyo sikoyo. Okoki mpe kofina "Need help now" na likolo ya ecran nyonso.
reentry.resourceOnly: Bokambi ya bisalelo kaka — Groundwork epesaka te mpe esalaka boyokani na moto te.

steps.step1: Senga mukanda ya kobotama na yo
steps.step2: Senga karte Social Security na yo
steps.step4: Tia mikano elongo na mokambi ya likambo
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Tala mikanda ya kobima na mikolo ya nsuka
steps.step10: Ndima mokolo ya check-in ya liboso na mibeko
steps.step12: Zwa ID ya etuka na yo
steps.step13: Zwa telefone, email na internet ya ofele
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: Bengana misala ya kozonga ya mboka
steps.step16: Yeba mibeko ya bokengi na yo
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step18: Tala ndenge ya permis ya kokamba
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step20: Zwa mikanda ya kolongonu na yo
steps.step23: Bongisa rendez-vous ya kolongonu ya makanisi
steps.step27: Tinda mikanda epai ya bato oyo bapesaka libaku ya mibale
steps.step28: Luka mateya to mikanda ya mosala
steps.step29: Fungola konte ya banke sala budget
steps.step30: Banda kotonga crédit na yo lisusu
steps.step31: Zongana na libota, bongisa lisungi ya bana soki esengeli
steps.step32: Sala programme ya mokolo na mokolo
steps.step33: Tia mokano ya molai sepela na mikolo 90 na yo

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Ya nkuku na ebandeli. Kabola kaka soki oponi.

venue.placeholder: Esika ya moke — shambre lokola boîte. Bazali na bifoto ya solo ya esika te; oyo ezali esika ya solo te.

family.help: Libota emonaka kaka oyo oponi kokabola.

readAloud.title: Kotanga na mongongo
readAloud.help: Kotanga na mongongo esalelaka mongongo ya aparei na yo mpo kotanga makomi.

phase3.resumeHelp: Sala resume ya makomi pete longwa na boyebi na yo.
phase3.headline: Moto
phase3.interviewHelp: Mekola biyano. Molakisi na yo apesaka points na litokoli moko.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Bato mosusu bamonaka engumba na yo kaka. Esika ya solo ekabolamaka te.
phase3.rideHelp: Senga motuka. Banumero ya telefone bamonanaka te. Bokutanaka na esika ya bato nyonso.
phase3.partnersHelp: Bituluku bike bike ya bato misato oyo batekaka baninga.
phase3.caption: Nkombo ya foto
phase3.qaTitle: Mituna na biyano na nkombo te
phase3.qaHelp: Tuna na nkombo te. Bale ki oyo bazali liboso bazali koyanola.
phase3.merchHelp: Bilebo ya code kaka. Eloko te libanda elimbolaka ntina na yango, mokolo te e imprimé.
phase3.shareHelp: Karte moko na banumero ya botamboli na yo.
phase3.archiveHelp: Kanga nsango mpo na yo moko. Efongolamaka na mokolo ya elembo.
phase3.matchHelp: Agent na yo asololaka nanu na baagent mosusu. Korendez-vous ekangami sikoyo. Okoki komona mpo na nini, kosenga koyebana mpe komeka lisusu.
phase3.datingOff: Rendez-vous ekangami kino mobeko ya mikolo mike ekotia.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Tala awa liboso. Ya kopona, niveau ya engumba kaka: tala nani akende na bongisi na yo mpe bosolola na bansango ya app. Telefone te, esika ya solo te.
phase3.groupsHelp: Bituluku ya kozonga, lisungi ya kozonga, kondima mpe lisanga kolanda engumba na tango ya bongisi. Data ya ndakisa kaka — liste ya solo te.
phase3.rideFallbackTitle: Nazali na mposa ya motuka (ya kosunga)
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Emonanaka kaka soki moto te na tableau akende na bongisi na yo. Etiaka bosengi oyo bakambi na app — niveau ya engumba kaka, telefone te.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Covoiturage te mpo na bongisi oyo, yango wana Nazali na mposa ya motuka emonanaka lokola ya kosunga.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Bachauffeur oyo bandimaki kaka. Bansango ekengeka moko na moko na kozela ya minutes 2; ondimaka liboso ya oyo elandi.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.calcResult: sanza kino na mokano na yo
phase3.musicHelp: Banzembo ya ndakisa kaka. Konte ya streaming te. Mosani ekangamaka kati na mateya ya akademi.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Miziki ekangami tango ozali kati na leçon.
phase3.shareWho: Sikoyo: yo kaka. Kosala lien epesaka moto nyonso na lien kotanga.
phase3.suggestHelp: Batokoli kaka — eloko te epublikaka kino obakisi.

crisisReply.onlyYou: Yo kaka okoki komona nsango oyo.
crisisReply.inboxTitle: Bansango ya nkuku mpo na yo
crisisReply.openCrisis: Fungola buton ya likama na baninga ya bokengi
